response.justification: While Bogdan is an accomplished full-stack engineer with current experience in AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks at re:cinq, he does not meet the critical minimum requirement of 8+ years building production-grade AI solutions. His extensive background is in web/backend systems engineering without demonstrated depth in machine learning, data science, or AI/ML production systems. Notably absent are Python expertise—essential for AI development—and any evidence of vector databases, RAG architectures, LLM optimization, or multi-agent frameworks. His AI-specific work at re:cinq, while promising, represents only months of experience rather than the required years of depth.
strengths: Currently working on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP framework development at re:cinq, directly addressing core technical needs
Demonstrated staff-level technical leadership with strong mentorship track record; proven ability to drive engineering excellence and knowledge sharing
Strong TypeScript and cloud platform expertise (AWS CDK), providing solid foundation for required technology stack
concerns: Does not meet the minimum 8+ years requirement for building production-grade AI solutions; AI-specific work began only in April 2025
No demonstrated expertise in Python, which is critical for ML/AI development and explicitly required alongside TypeScript for AI solutions
No evidence of experience with vector databases, RAG architectures, LLM performance optimization, or multi-agent frameworks like LangGraph or CrewAI

key_factors.factor: Missing Python expertise for AI development
Current agentic infrastructure and MCP work at re:cinq
